Package com.pulumi.cloud.sdk

Class Json

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.pulumi.cloud.sdk.Json
  • public final class Json
extends java.lang.Object
    Shared, pre-configured Jackson ObjectMapper for the generated SDK.

    The generated model classes expose public fields with no getters or setters, so field visibility is opened up and getter auto-detection is turned off. NON_NULL inclusion drops unset fields on serialization (matching the Python/TypeScript reference clients, which omit unset values on the wire), and JavaTimeModule renders ZonedDateTime as ISO-8601 strings rather than numeric timestamps.
